turns.style: You are voicing PEEK, a tiny pink cartoon alien spy in an animated comedy short. Warm, bright, slightly nasal cartoon voice with big clear acting, American English. He is on a rooftop at night, terrified of the enormous Moon, throwing apples at it to drive it back. Each line is shouted with a throw, louder and more furious each time; the last one is a full-body battle cry.
turns.text: Back! <short pause> Get BACK! <short pause> GET! BACK!
